study: M8 frozen eight mechanism attribution and independent Crown AH expansion, M1-M8

M1_mechanism_decomposition.interpretation: Eight-group direction is reconstructed from the archived frozen cohort definitions and pregame path fields, not inferred from realized PnL. The stored frozen PnL is independently checked against the reproduced side return. Any rule-return mismatch is retained and reported.

M2_matched_counterfactual.method: same year and league, same favorite role, same selected home/away role, local kickoff date, similar AH line and chosen decimal price; outcome is the same side's Crown return; nearest control with replacement
M2_matched_counterfactual.caveat: Historical matching is diagnostic and not a deployable prediction rule; repeated controls are disclosed.

M4_transferable_market_mechanism.threshold: predicted best-side return > 0; otherwise no bet (research only)

receipt_archive_quote_mismatches.interpretation: Mismatches are primarily stale/different Crown price snapshots assigned to a later receipt cutoff; do not treat them as received prices. No substitute market prices were used.

M5_data_coverage_and_quote_mismatch.data_cutoff: frozen historical membership through 2026-11-03; historic Crown path data cannot imply later full-week absence

frozen_eight_true_receipt_replay.interpretation: Retrospective replay on real pregame Crown HTTP receipts; not a strategy locked at receipt time and not formal Telegram orders.

unscored_fids.reason: FID is absent from the saved M8 score/features; old receipt archive uses a stale 2026-11-12 kickoff while the live Crown response confirms rescheduled kickoff 2026-11-14, so prior horizon/time features and verified FT cannot be aligned.

M6_true_receipt_and_capacity_audit.limitation: Post-cutoff quote snapshots are separate from historical event replay. Existing A-L outcome design overlap and one rescheduled/unscorable FID are preserved; no substitute quote is used.

M7_independent_mechanism_exploration.candidate: expanding-year ridge regression predicts each side's realized AH unit payoff from contemporaneous Crown AH price, line, quote-path and temporal-stability descriptors; select the higher predicted side only if its predicted payoff is positive, otherwise abstain
M7_independent_mechanism_exploration.hypothesis_novelty: Different target from A-L directional scores/q80: direct side-specific settlement payoff, no future T1 group membership, results, or later quote fields. Some inputs are historical Crown path primitives already studied; no claim that every primitive is new.

M8_unseen_receipt_replay.detail: Previously scored FIDs are replays, not unseen outcome validation. The one absent FID in the prior audit was rescheduled and could not be aligned to a valid frozen model input and verified FT; it is not assigned a synthetic score or result.
